app.name: Attendance
app.description: Control panel for the face recognition attendance system

common.failed: That did not go through, try again
common.failedHint: The network may have dropped, or the server is busy. Try once more.

login.lead: Sign in to reach the control panel
login.refused: That email or password is wrong

overview.title: Overview
overview.feedEmpty: Nothing has happened since this page opened
overview.contractsHint: A fixed term left to lapse becomes indefinite by law.
overview.probationHint: Probation that ends undecided becomes a permanent hire.

employees.title: Employees
employees.assignLead: The kiosk asks this person for a face sample the next time they stand in front of it
employees.assignNone: No kiosk has been approved yet
employees.emptyHint: Nobody in the directory yet. Add the first person to start.
employees.importDry: Dry run: {rows} rows, {created} to create, {updated} to update.
employees.importFaults: {n} faults left — fix the file and pick it again.
employees.trainingWaiting: The training tab waits on the training module (KEHOACH 9.16 item 13)

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lead: The last column counts records the kiosk itself flagged as an unsynced clock
attendance.rangeEmpty: Nobody checked in during this range
attendance.badRange: The start date has to come before the end date
attendance.historyEmpty: This person has no punches yet

devices.title: Devices
devices.lead: An unclaimed kiosk stays PENDING until somebody matches the code on its screen
devices.otaLead: The kiosk downloads the release and checks its sha256; one wrong byte sends it back to what it was running
devices.otaNone: No release has been published yet
devices.otaSame: This kiosk already runs that release

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.lead: A retired shift still reads, because old assignments still point at it
shifts.name: Shift

reports.title: Reports
reports.insuranceLead: Three monthly filings, from start dates, leaving dates, and a contribution base that moved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageLead: Changing the language changes the address too, so a link you send carries the language with it
settings.provisionLead: Every active employee with a personal email and no account is emailed a link to set their own password. Anyone with people reporting to them starts as a manager.
settings.provisionNone: Nobody is waiting. An employee with no personal email on file cannot be given one.
settings.provisionOnce: Each person gets an email with a link to set their own password.
settings.themeLead: Follows the system by default; a manual choice stays on this device.
settings.provisionWaiting: {count} people still have no login. Run it again to carry on.

me.title: My page
me.dependentsLead: Register here; the deduction starts once HR accepts it. The start month is the first month counted.
me.noProfile: This account is not attached to an employee record
me.askLetterHint: Employment or income, numbered by HR
me.myPayslipsHint: Issued periods and what changed since the last one
me.askProfileHint: Email, phone, where your pay goes — ask, and HR answers

payroll.title: Payslip
payroll.lead: One row per component, earnings and deductions apart.
payroll.lockLead: Once locked, late data goes to the next period.
payroll.emptyHint: Create a run and press Run to produce payslips.
payroll.advanceLead: Approve, then pay; the next payroll run recovers it.

policy.title: Pay policy
policy.lead: Deductions, contribution rates and the tax table, by effective date.

errors.NOT_AN_EMPLOYEE: This account is not attached to an employee record.
errors.DATE_RANGE_BACKWARDS: The end date comes before the start date.
errors.LEAVE_OVERLAP: These days overlap a request you already filed.
errors.LEAVE_BALANCE_SHORT: There is not enough leave left for this range.
errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_DECIDED: Somebody has already answered this request.
errors.NOT_YOUR_REQUEST: This request is not yours to decide.
errors.DEPARTMENT_CYCLE: That parent department sits under this one.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last administrator cannot be removed.
errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: This person already starts that shift on that date.
errors.CURSOR_INVALID: That page position is not valid. Reload the list.
errors.CREDENTIALS_REJECTED: That email and password do not match.
errors.REFRESH_REPLAYED: The session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.SESSION_CLOSED: This device has been signed out. Sign in again.
errors.PAY_WRITE_DENIED: You may not change pay records.
errors.POLICY_MISSING: No pay policy is in force for this period.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_OPEN: The period is locked and cannot be recalculated.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_LOCKED: The period is not locked yet.
errors.CHECKLIST_NOT_CLEAR: Items are still open; tick the box to lock anyway.
errors.ADVANCE_PAY_DENIED: You may not pay advances out.
errors.ADVANCE_ALREADY_DECIDED: This advance has already been answered.
errors.ADVANCE_NOT_APPROVED: This advance has not been approved.
errors.SELF_DECIDE: You cannot decide your own request.
errors.RUN_KIND_NOT_READY: The calculation for this kind of run is not built yet.
errors.BONUS_RUN_HAS_NO_ITEMS: This bonus run has no amounts to pay.
errors.BONUS_NEEDS_A_REGULAR_PAYSLIP: Somebody has no monthly payslip for this period; run the monthly pay first.
errors.RUN_IS_NOT_A_BONUS: That run is not a bonus run.
errors.FIX_ONE_DAY_ONLY: A correction covers one day. File one request per day.
errors.FIX_DAY_NOT_FINISHED: That day has not finished yet.
errors.BIOMETRIC_CONSENT_MISSING: This person has not agreed to face data being used.
errors.CONSENT_NOT_YOURS: You may only agree for yourself.
errors.CONSENT_NOT_GRANTED: There is no agreement to withdraw.
errors.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the server. Check the API is running at the address this page calls.
errors.ASSET_ALREADY_ISSUED: Somebody is already holding this asset.
errors.ASSET_NOT_ISSUED: This asset is not out with anyone.
errors.ASSET_HELD_BY_SOMEBODY_ELSE: Somebody else is holding this asset.
errors.MANAGER_CYCLE: That arrangement makes a loop of managers.
errors.REORG_NEEDS_A_SELECTION: Choose a department or a list of people to move.
errors.REORG_NEEDS_A_DESTINATION: Choose a new department or a new manager.
errors.CHECKLIST_ALREADY_STARTED: This person already has a checklist of that kind.
errors.CHECKLIST_NOT_FOUND: No checklist has been started for this person.
errors.NO_CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE: No template matches this job title and department.
errors.TASK_ALREADY_DONE: Somebody has already marked this done.
errors.HOLIDAY_ALREADY_SET: That date is already a holiday.
errors.DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP_REJECTED: This machine is not accepted into the system.
errors.SETUP_LINK_SPENT: This link has been used or has expired. Ask HR for a new one.
errors.CERTIFICATE_ALREADY_DECIDED: This request has already been answered.
errors.CERTIFICATE_NOT_ISSUED: The letter has not been issued yet.
errors.PROFILE_FIELD_EMPTY: A box is still empty. A bank change needs both the bank and the account number.
errors.PROFILE_NO_CHANGE: The new value matches what the record already holds.
errors.PROFILE_CHANGE_PENDING: A change to this is already waiting for a decision.
errors.PROFILE_CHANGE_DECIDED: This request has already been answered.
errors.PROFILE_SELF_DECIDE: Whoever asked for a change cannot be the one who approves it.
errors.HR_ONLY: Only the HR desk can do this.
errors.NO_EMPLOYEE_RECORD: This account is not linked to an employee record.
errors.PAYSLIP_NOT_ISSUED: The payslip has not been issued, so there is nothing to dispute yet.
errors.DISPUTE_ALREADY_OPEN: A dispute about this is already waiting for an answer.
errors.DISPUTE_ALREADY_ANSWERED: This dispute has already been answered.

timesheet.title: Timesheet
timesheet.lead: Totals per person for the range; tap somebody to see their days.
timesheet.empty: No day rows built for this range
timesheet.emptyHint: Press Rebuild to fold punches into days.
timesheet.buildQueued: Rebuild queued. Refresh once it has run.

notices.title: Notifications
notices.kindREQUEST_WAITING: A request is waiting on you
notices.pushLead: Turn on to hear even with the page closed.
notices.pushBlocked: The browser has blocked notifications; allow them in its settings.
notices.pushUnsupported: This device does not support push notifications.
notices.prefsLead: Four kinds, each switched on its own.

org.departmentsLead: The org tree; changing a parent changes who approves and who can see.
org.name: Name
org.holidaysLead: Without a row here, a public holiday counts as absent and is docked.
org.holidaysEmpty: No holidays entered for this year

setPassword.lead: Set a password to open your account
setPassword.noToken: This address carries no code. Open the link from your email.

myShifts.title: My shifts
myShifts.lead: This month and the ones ahead, so you can plan around them.

certificates.title: Letters
certificates.lead: Ask for a letter of employment or of income; HR approves and numbers it.
certificates.purposeHint: For example: a bank loan, a visa, a course

profile.title: Change a personal detail
profile.lead: A change is a request; HR reads it before the record moves.
profile.bankWarning: Changing where your pay goes warns the address on file, and leaves a locked period alone.

disputes.title: Dispute a payslip
disputes.lead: It becomes a record, with a deadline to answer and an outcome kept.
disputes.claim: Which figure is wrong, and why
disputes.claimHint: For example: four hours of overtime are missing
disputes.answerHint: Say what was checked against what
disputes.amountHint: Leave empty if nothing is owed; an amount rides the next payroll
disputes.empty: No dispute on this payslip yet
disputes.inboxTitle: Payslip disputes waiting for an answer
disputes.paid: An adjustment for the next period has been made
